archetypes.name: dyn-checks-digest
archetypes.rationale: The change adds best-effort parsing and truncation for failure diagnostics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed relevant-checks digest parser and writer. Focus on whether every redacted failure path emits a bounded digest without changing repair-loop behavior. Check multi-hook attribution, DEFECT handling, UTF-8 byte caps, and fallback behavior when digest writing fails. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
